stem: Ananya notices that a puddle on the school courtyard is smaller after lunch.

options.text: Measuring the puddle each hour and noting the change
Saying puddles always shrink, with no check
Ignoring the puddle because it is ordinary

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: She observes and measures to understand a change in the world.

teacher.key_rationale: Science is asking questions, observing, and exploring, not skipping a check.
